heading: People who lead.
intro: ERS–WVSU is coordinated by an initiating team and strengthened by a wider community of seminar participants, research collaborators, faculty mentors, and students. Roles below distinguish leadership from participation and recognize evolving contributions.
invitation_title: There is a place for thoughtful contributors.
invitation_text: Interested faculty, researchers, students, and partners can join discussions or explore a substantive role when economics, data analysis, or causal inference can strengthen the work.
